lock_note: This lock supplies an explicit unconditional prime-number-theorem error bound used only to prove finite L2 moments for the combined signed Chebyshev kernel. It supplies no Weil positivity, no assumed zero list, no sector floor, and no equation (5.2) conclusion.

binding_sources.title: Sharper bounds for the Chebyshev function psi(x)

locked_formulas.source_bound: abs(psi(X)-X)/X < 9.22022*(log X)^(3/2)*exp(-0.8476836*sqrt(log X)) for every X>2
locked_formulas.log_coordinate_conversion: abs(1-exp(-x)*psi(exp(x))) < A*x^(3/2)*exp(-alpha*sqrt(x)) for x>log(2), with A=9.22022 and alpha=0.8476836
locked_formulas.moment_conclusion: integral_0^infinity abs(delta_star(x))^2 dx and integral_0^infinity x*abs(delta_star(x))^2 dx are finite

version_caveat: The arXiv abstract HTML displays the older 9.22106 decimal. The vendored v3 PDF displays 9.22022 in Corollary 1.4 and is the binding source byte sequence.
not_locked_or_claimed: no assumed list of real zeta zeros
